en-US.description: Backup and sync game save files across Steam Deck, Windows, and Linux
en-US.longDescription: A lightweight desktop app for backing up and syncing game save files across Steam Deck, Windows PC, and Linux. Detects saves from Steam and non-Steam launchers, creates versioned backups, and syncs between devices via Syncthing.
en-US.name: DeckSave
